title: Information-Theoretic Digital Twins for Stealthy Attack Detection in Industrial Control Systems: A Closed-Form KL Divergence Approach
summary: Digital twins (DTs) are increasingly used to monitor and secure Industrial Control Systems (ICS), yet detecting stealthy False Data Injection Attacks (FDIAs) that manipulate system states within normal physical bounds remains challenging. Deep learning anomaly detectors often over-generalize such subtle manipulations, while classical fault detection methods do not scale well in highly correlated multivariate systems.
